name: draft20
description: Draft 20 — build de CSS (Tailwind) y minificado de JS

scripts.build:js: terser js/app.core.js -c -m -o js/app.core.min.js && terser js/app.game.js -c -m -o js/app.game.min.js && terser js/bot_policy.js -c -m -o js/bot_policy.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.test: npm run test:php && npm run test:node && npm run check:css
scripts.test:php: php tools/test_catalogo.php && php tests/rate_limit.test.php && php tests/base_items.test.php
scripts.test:node: node tests/bot_policy.test.js && node tests/a11y.test.js && node tests/ssr_lobby.test.js
scripts.check:css: npm run build:css && git diff --exit-code -- css/tailwind.css
scripts.gen:assets: node tools/gen_emoji.js && node tools/gen_flags.js && svgo --folder img/emoji --multipass
